story: Midjourney launches Niji V8, its anime image model, with a built-in editing model and consistent characters

segments.label: THIS WEEK IN AI
segments.title: Niji 8 keeps anime characters consistent
segments.narration: Midjourney's anime model now keeps characters consistent across scenes.

segments.label: WHAT HAPPENED
segments.title: Midjourney launches Niji 8
segments.narration: Midjourney launched Niji eight on November twenty-fourth, with a built-in editing model, developed with Spellbrush.

segments.label: HOW IT WORKS
segments.title: Quick Edit poses characters in new scenes
segments.narration: Use Quick Edit to attach character sheets and backgrounds, then pose your character in new scenes.

segments.label: WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU
segments.title: Good for mascots, with catches
segments.narration: Good for mascots and ads. The catch: identical prompts no longer return the same character, and blurry references hurt results.

segments.label: OUR TAKE
segments.title: Test with sharp references first
segments.narration: Our take: test it with sharp reference images before planning any campaign.
